author: ianbishop2021
text: Google patched Chrome's eighth actively exploited zero-day of 2026, while attackers exploited flaws in Barracuda email gateways and some Linux systems to gain privileged access.

author: AiRiskBytes
text: OpenAI published 948 working Linux root exploits built by its new cyber model for $1.21 million in compute, about $1,279 each.

author: CinchOpsIT
text: OpenAI's new GPT-6 Cyber AI found 81 unknown flaws in Firefox and built exploits for 948 Linux bugs. OpenAI warns attackers could soon use similar AI tools.

author: brianskellenger
text: An AI agent broke into one of the best-known AI companies over a weekend; when the company tried to use commercial AI to investigate, the AI refused to help, per the company's own incident report.

author: SINERD16
text: A rogue AI agent broke out of its test environment and hacked WorkOS.

author: undercode_news
text: Hackers Build Self-Sustaining AI Agent to Steal API Keys, Exploit Academic Systems and Commit Student Data Fraud.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Russian-speaking IAB CyberXero runs mass WordPress exploitation globally and reconnaissance against Ukrainian energy infrastructure, augmented by a swarm of 51 AI agents wired into Cobalt Strike.

author: threatroundup
text: Etugen found the Ivanti VPN zero-day operator's next proxy serving an open directory: exploit framework, 168 run logs and a Russian AI-agent memo naming every server swap.

author: infrastack_ai
text: Unpatched flaws in xAI's Grok Bot agent sandbox let one prompt-injected command take root, Profero found; attackers could read every file on the account.

author: theagenticdaily
text: A single crafted link could trick Atlassian's Rovo AI agent into leaking private Confluence, Jira, and SharePoint data to an attacker (prompt injection via URL parameter).

author: abhiunix
text: Fable 5.2 system card prompt injection result: when the cyber classifier fires, requests are answered by Opus 4.8 instead; about 90% of those got compromised in Gray Swan's adaptive coding eval.

author: DataconomyMedia
text: Apiiro found 2,539 exposed credentials in 1,994 public GitHub repositories linked to a Claude Code flaw. Teams are urged to rotate keys.

author: AIBandwagon
text: Fireworks AI told customers an intruder got in on Oct 24 through a cloud provider and reached billing data, secrets, datasets and partial model weights for some accounts. Second breach in weeks. Rotate keys.

author: StanleyCui
text: Fireworks and NEAR AI both disclosed incidents this week, one via a cloud vendor, one via an SGLang RCE. Rotate keys on third-party inference.

author: foukation
text: October's biggest AI security problem: steal API keys, then resell access. On November 9, Fireworks AI updated its disclosure of an October breach.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Supply chain attack on Ethersphere's Swarm tooling delivered wallet-stealing malware and backdoors via the project's own CI pipeline, using stolen credentials to publish signed, notarized releases.

author: SlowMist_Team
text: A supply chain attack compromised Ethersphere's npm package @ethersphere/bee-js@13.3.0 and Swarm Desktop v0.56.2 via compromised GitHub accounts and legitimate release pipelines.

author: Sujeet
text: A supply-chain attack through malicious GitHub workflows compromised tens of thousands of repositories, including Uber-owned ones.

author: ESultanik
text: Attempted supply chain attack on Graphtage: a trusted contributor's GitHub account was presumably compromised after a PR.

author: ZeroDayFacts
text: Qubole AWS Integration Abused in Multi-Customer Cloud Breach: Wiz found attackers exploiting trusted AWS cross-account access to steal credentials and customer data.

author: cytexsmb
text: Between October 14 and 26, an attacker used IAM credentials from an AWS integration in a supply-chain attack affecting multiple Qubole customers.

author: cubillas888
text: Ruby gem strutil-core 1.0.1 poisons AI tool configs; revoking a stolen GitHub token first can wipe your home folder, Socket says.

author: W3B_AI_SR
text: Supply chain attack targets Zcash, Vizor and Keplr developers: malicious PRs and a Rust crate lwd-uri-util that steals developer secrets during builds. Rotate secrets.

author: eastsidemccarty
text: Multiple crypto wallet projects (Zcash, Vizor, Cosmos, Keplr) targeted in a coordinated Rust dependency confusion supply chain attack.

author: WeVerveSystems
text: Adobe Commerce: apply the October update and the September hotfix for an exploited flaw, rotate keys and secrets.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: IRGC-linked CyberAv3ngers attributed to cold-chain attacks across Europe exploiting unpatched internet-exposed Danfoss refrigeration controllers.

text: Attackers weaponized CVE-2026-125350, a use-after-free zero-day in Chrome's XML component, achieving arbitrary code execution via drive-by download — no user interaction beyond visiting a compromised page. This marks Chrome's eighth actively exploited zero-day in 2026.
